reason: The registered strongest fixed comparator is Gaussian, while the adaptive policy updates a library mixture. Add an identical-posterior comparator to isolate acquisition from posterior model choice.
hypothesis: The observation-dependent acquisition sequence improves terminal utility over a batch sequence with the same library-particle posterior, sources, nuisance treatment, observation noise, candidates and measurement budget.
design: Construct all actions from initial ParticlePosterior joint Gaussian-moment covariance and terminal selective mean, performing only covariance Schur updates with zero innovation. Then acquire the scheduled true recorded values and update the identical ParticlePosterior used by adaptive_dual.
parameters: Inherit tau/sigma from CALIBRATION_FREEZE.json; no new fitting, winner selection or test adjustment.
population: The identical 281 calibration and 421 algorithm-test campaign inputs as the primary replay.
cost: One batch turnaround, the same 2/4/8/16 measurement cost curve.
statistics: Secondary paired utility, precision, selective correlation and independent-secondary measures, with the same drug bootstrap/signflip and mechanism-cluster sensitivity. This contrast cannot rescue a failed primary dual-core gate.
interpretation: A positive contrast supports this deterministic observation-dependent planner on retrospective data; no LLM or fresh biological effect is inferred.
